entities.summary: Iulia Yevhenivna Paratova is a Ukrainian weightlifter. She competed at the 2012 Summer Olympics in the Women's 53 kg, finishing 3rd after gold medallist Zulfiya Chinshanlo and bronze medallist Cristina Iovu were both disqualified. Paratova also competed for Ukraine at the 2016 Summer Olympics.
